### Callout hardcoded for dark
Notice. This callout hardcodes a #111111 background with #dddddd body text and a #333333 border. It never consults the page theme.

Muted secondary line at #aaaaaa with no background set, so it sits directly on the message surface.

inline chip #ccc on #222 Normal themed prose follows for comparison.
intent: raw HTML block hardcoding a DARK palette via inline style (near-black fill, pale text) - must survive light
